_note: Oregon 2026 election cycle: key dates and official links for the November 3, 2026 general election. Each date was read on the official page in key_date_sources on the day in key_date_retrieved. The U.S. Senate, U.S. House and Governor races list every candidate on the state's certified list for the November 3 ballot (roster_source_url on each race), in alphabetical order by last name; write-in candidates are not listed.

voter_info._note: Read by election reminders (backend/app/services/election_reminders.py) and shown on the Elections tab. Every date has its official source in key_date_sources and the day it was read in key_date_retrieved (data lint E-11, E-12). Checked on the official pages 2026-10-15.

vote_by_mail_request_deadline_general.reason: Every active registered voter in Oregon is mailed a ballot, so no request is needed.

early_voting_window_general.reason: Oregon has no early in-person voting period.

races.general_candidates_note: Every candidate on Oregon Secretary of State, Directive 2026-09, Official Ballot Statement for the General Election on November 3, 2026 (September 3, 2026; Multnomah County's official copy) for the November 3, 2026 general election, in alphabetical order by last name. Write-in candidates are not listed.
